3d: 3D is a movie with images having three dimensional form or appearance.
3D can also mean having a three-dimensional form or appearance.
3D means the same as three-D or 3-D.
3d radar: 3d radar is radar that will report altitude as well as azimuth and distance of a target.
3d radar means the same as three-dimensional radar.
2d: 2d means coming next after the first in position in space or time or degree or magnitude.
2d means the same as second or 2nd.
